brief.zh: 让 AI 更新已有清单时，写明必须加入、必须去掉和应该保留的内容。
brief.en: When AI updates an existing list, spell out what to add, what to remove, and what to keep.

concept.zh: 把任务限制写成可以核对的要求。

title.zh: 说明必须有和不能有的物品
title.en: Name what must be in or out

body.zh: 给 AI 一份草稿时，AI 可能保留你没提到的物品。如果不允许带某样物品，就写清楚要把它从清单里去掉。
body.en: When AI starts from a draft, it may keep items you did not mention. If an item is forbidden, tell it to remove that item from the list.

title.en: Preserve the entries that are already correct

body.zh: 如果草稿里已经有合适的数量，可以写“保留已有的 2 片滤网”。新清单出来后，要同时检查新增、排除和保留的内容。
body.en: If the draft already has the right count, say “Keep the 2 filters already listed.” Then check additions, exclusions, and preserved entries in the new list.

prompt.zh: 草稿有 2 片滤网和 1 瓶胶水。任务要求保留滤网，再加 1 把刷子，并且不能有胶水。哪条提示最清楚？
prompt.en: The draft contains 2 filters and 1 bottle of glue. The task is to keep the filters, add 1 brush, and leave out the glue. Which prompt is clearest?

options.zh: 请向草稿添加 1 把刷子。
请保留 2 片滤网，加入 1 把刷子，去掉胶水。
options.en: Keep the 2 filters, add 1 brush, and remove the glue.
Discard the draft and remove the glue.

feedback.zh: 这条提示把保留、增加和删除都写清了，可以逐项验收。
feedback.en: This prompt names precisely what to keep, add, and remove. Each change can be verified.

caption.zh: 先读草稿。滤网数量合适，胶水却违反规定。
caption.en: Read the draft. The filter count is right, but the glue breaks the rule.

caption.zh: 只说“加一把刷子”，胶水可能还在。
caption.en: If you only say “Add one brush,” the glue may remain.

caption.zh: 明确说出“去掉胶水，保留原来的 2 片滤网和 1 把刷子”，再核对结果。
caption.en: Say “Remove the glue and keep the 2 filters and 1 brush.” Then check the result.
